plain_english_explanation: The domain 'paypa1-security-center.com' employs character substitution ('1' for 'l') to mimic PayPal and steal login credentials.
submitted_content: Your PayPal account has been limited due to suspicious activity. Verify identity: https://paypa1-security-center.com/login

url_analysis.character_substitution: Levenshtein edit distance of 1 between 'paypa1' and brand 'paypal'

highlighted_quotes: Your PayPal account has been limited

why_dangerous.title: Brand Trademark Typosquatting
why_dangerous.description: Host substitutes character '1' for letter 'l' to deceive hurried users into surrendering financial credentials.

recommended_actions: DO NOT click the link or enter your login credentials.
Navigate directly to paypal.com in your web browser.
Report the spoofed URL to spoof@paypal.com.
